lower_description: large smooth very dark flagstones seen from above, big plain rectangular slabs, very dark charcoal #2c2e33, thin black mortar, plain, calm
upper_description: the roof of a stone castle keep seen from above, small overlapping dark grey slate tiles laid in even staggered rows, iron grey #4a4d54 and #2c2e33 with thin black gaps, a few lighter #6e727a edges on the upper left of each slate, weathered, calm, no moss, no pattern marks
